f2.text:
Colors, type, spacing, shape, elevation, states, layout and icons live in the design system "Evermoon" (tokens, README, component cards). This board is a quick visual check of the same tokens in the app context.

All values follow Material 3: 4 dp spacing grid, M3 corner scale and type scale, M3 state layers.

l3.text:
Resizing (fill / hug / fixed):
• Top app bar: fill width, fixed 64 dp; title hugs.
• List: fill width and remaining height, scrolls; cards fill width, hug height.
• FAB: fixed 56 dp, pinned 16 dp from the end and 16 dp above the bottom inset (M3).
• Form: fields fill width; the Save bar is fixed to the bottom above the gesture inset; content scrolls under it with bottom padding = bar height + inset.
• Drawer: fixed 316 dp, fill height.

"Upcoming list — 360 dp check" is the same screen on a narrow phone.

l4.text: All names and dates are illustrative placeholders, not computed lunar dates. The home list is read-only: edit and delete happen in the calendar.

c3.text:
Decided 2026-11-11: the app ships the drawer.

Calendar: tap a day in the month to list its events below. Swipe an anniversary left to reveal Sửa (opens the edit form) and right to reveal Xoá (asks to confirm). Holidays cannot be edited. The week view uses the same items. The year view has no row actions: tap a month to open it.

Purple dot = anniversary, red dot = mùng 1, rằm and Tết. The year tiles count named festivals only, not every mùng 1 and rằm. The home list is read-only.

c4.text: Resizing: the month grid has 7 equal columns that fill the width (cells 52 dp tall); the day list fills the remaining height and scrolls; year tiles are 3 equal columns with a fixed 104 dp height so rows stay aligned. "Calendar month — 360 dp check" shows the grid on a narrow phone.

s2.text: Language and theme apply at once (no Save). Reminder time and days before are set per event in the form. Terms and privacy are here, not in the drawer.

a1.text: Archive — not part of the build

a2.text:
A — standard M3 drawer (row 1, "Navigation drawer open"): pill indicator, plain header.

B — today card: a primary card with today's lunar date and today's anniversary on top, destinations with tonal icon tiles and a count badge, version at the bottom.

C — compact with context: app mark and today's lunar date in the header, a left-bar selected indicator with counts, the next three anniversaries inside the drawer, Settings as the third destination.

Dates are illustrative placeholders.

The app ships drawer style A (Flow pages). The bottom-bar design and the logo rounds are in the canvas "Evermoon - Archive".

o3.text:
First launch: Splash → Intro 1 → 2 → 3 → Bật thông báo → empty list. "Bỏ qua" jumps to the permission screen. Later launches: Splash → upcoming list.

Splash: Android 12+ SplashScreen, icon only, no text. The icon pops in and the crescent turns into place: an AnimatedVectorDrawable of at most 1000 ms (the canvas loops it so it can be seen). Reduced motion shows the still icon.

Intro: one picture, a title of a few words and one short line per screen.

The permission screen comes before the Android 13+ system dialog; "Để sau" never asks again on its own.
